metadata.description: Agent Skills for working with Skardi — SQL pipelines as HTTP endpoints. Distributes plugins that teach AI coding agents Skardi's patterns for building searchable context, hybrid search, and connectors.

plugins.name: auto-context
plugins.description: Turn a folder of documents, a table you already have, or documents still inside a service (a wiki, cloud docs, a mailbox) into governed, searchable context an agent can query. Hybrid search (vector + full-text) served over HTTP by skardi-server. Three raw-material entries, one flow: a folder; an existing table (read-only; NDJSON for any datastore); or fetch-and-land, where your agent writes the per-source fetch code and the skill fixes the process and its reconciliation. Storage is a separate choice: defaults to a local SQLite file the skill creates and owns, or point it at Postgres+pgvector, MongoDB, or Lance when the index should live in a database you already own.

plugins.name: feishu-connector
plugins.description: Sync a Feishu/Lark Bitable into local SQLite via lark-cli, then register it as a Skardi data source so an agent can query it with SQL. v1: manual one-shot sync, Bitable only.
